messages:
oliver: Heads-up — hit a tail latency spike on prod around 02:14 that looks like a slab surge + pinned backpressure. Small allocations (<= 2KB) are getting pinned in GPU staging and we end up with long stall chains.

oliver: Root cause sketch: our host-staging pool aggressively pins micropages during concurrent inference bursts; when eviction can't keep up we see request queuing + cross-tenant redispatch.

maria: Oof. Any simple mitigation we can ship quickly? lower the aggressive pin threshold? :thinking_face:

oliver: Two short-term knobs: 1) reduce pinned-window ms from 300 -> 40 (less chance of long pins), 2) move tiny allocs to ephemeral-mmap fastpath that prefers host-backed but never pins across requests.

raj: Counterpoint: ephemeral-mmap will increase pagefault churn and may regress cold-start latency. We should consider a consolidated staging policy instead: maintain a tiny-allocation slab with soft-evict credits per-tenant and a global reclaim token bucket. If bucket empty, fall back to ephemeral path.

raj: Pseudo-config: 
```
tiny_slab.max_pages = 1024
tiny_slab.per_tenant_soft_credits = 8
global_reclaim_burst = 64
ephemeral_fallback = true
```

raj: Idea is avoid pinning across many tenants while still giving hot microrequests fast path.

maria: That sounds reasonable. What about fairness — how to avoid a noisy tenant burning all soft credits?

raj: soft credits decay with an LRU-ish aging and we cap per-tenant burst to 2x baseline. Also telemetry: track soft_credit_consumed and slow-path rate.

oliver: Tradeoffs to call out: slower cold inference if we rely on ephemeral fallback; more pagefaults but avoids global stalls. Also complexity of accounting and extra telemetry.

sophia: From observability side, we need these new metrics: tiny_slab.usage, tiny_slab.evictions, ephemeral.pf_rate, per_tenant.soft_credit_consumed. Also add a sampler to capture stack traces on the first N stalls per minute.

maria: Is there any hardware-level knob? HMM/GPU driver features? Maybe we can tweak pin granularity?

oliver: Not reliably across instances; driver-level pin coalescing differs by vendor. We should expose a runtime hint but not depend on it.

ci-bot: Build failed on branch spike/ephemeral-fastpath — test_infer_small_allocations.py::test_concurrent_leak (flaky). Logs: 
```
AssertionError: expected <= 50ms, got 230ms
```

raj: Thanks CI — that's the flaky repro we need. I'll spin up a local spike that toggles soft-credit and ephemeral fallback and watch pf-rate.

oliver: Proposal: implement consolidated tiny_slab w/ soft credits + ephemeral fallback as an opt-in feature flag behind a rollout (canary 5% instances). Ship telemetry and a toggle to drop pinned-window to 40ms as emergency kill-switch.

maria: SG. Action items: 
- raj: prototype spike + perf matrix (pf-rate, p99 latency, eviction rate) by EOD tomorrow
- oliver: add telemetry names/alert thresholds + emergency knob in console
- sophia: add tracing sampler and dashboard skeleton

raj: ACK. I'll post raw numbers and config in a follow-up thread.

oliver: Thanks. If spike looks good we'll fold into an RFC for allocator contract changes (interface for per-tenant credits + reclamation hooks).

sophia: :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — keeping this high priority until we have a stable mitigation.
